text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"\"lense of their interest,\" \"incentified,\" \"refering,\" \"inientify\"","quality":"spelling control","description":"This captures more accurate conventional spelling and fewer disruptive misspellings that interfere with readability."},{"evidence":"multi-paragraph argument with \"Firstly,\" \"Secondly,\" \"Lastly,\" and a conclusion","quality":"organizational structure","description":"This captures a clearer overall essay structure with an introduction, sequenced body points, and a closing."},{"evidence":"\"For example, most middle schools conduct science fairs...\"","quality":"development with examples","description":"This captures fuller support for claims through extended, relevant examples and analogies."},{"evidence":"\"If teachers design the summer project... however, not all students think alike\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"This captures more varied and controlled sentence structures that maintain meaning more cleanly across longer stretches."},{"evidence":"\"therefore, allowing students to design their own summer projects allows...\"","quality":"academic vocabulary","description":"This captures stronger use of topic-appropriate academic language and abstract wording."}]}
